component.name: Entra RDP
component.summary: Remote desktop for Entra ID joined Windows hosts

description.p: Entra RDP connects to Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) joined Windows machines using native web account sign-in — the Linux equivalent of the "Use a web account to sign in to the remote computer" option in the Windows Remote Desktop client.

Distribution-packaged FreeRDP is normally built without WebView support, which downgrades sign-in to printing a login URL that must be pasted into a browser and pasted back. Entra RDP detects whether the FreeRDP binary in use actually supports the embedded browser, and warns clearly when it does not.

ul.li: Native embedded browser sign-in for Entra ID accounts
Named connection profiles for multiple hosts and tenants
Toggles for audio, microphone, clipboard, drive and printer redirection
Live command preview, so nothing is hidden behind the interface
Automatic detection of WebView capability in the FreeRDP binary
